summary: Using this medicine for a long time can cause cloudy areas in the eye's lens called cataracts, higher fluid pressure in the eye that can harm the main eye nerve and impair your sight, and a weakened body defense system [3]. In addition, computer model predictions—not tests in humans—suggest low risk scores for both liver and heart issues [M]. While three clinical research studies were stopped early, the reasons were low enrollment, low accrual, and the start of a competing trial rather than safety concerns [5][6][7].
